Cancellation is a separately authorised outcome.<br><br><b>State Machine Invariant:</b> Task states (Assigned → In Progress → Waiting for Review → Under Review → Closed) are strictly controlled by formal lifecycle transitions, never mutated directly by note additions or file uploads." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="1976" x="112" y="3320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="new-389" parent="layer2" style="whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Verdana;fontSize=16;spacing=12;strokeWidth=1.5;rounded=1;arcSize=8;align=left;fillColor=#F5F7FA;strokeColor=#728294;fontColor=#152735;" value="<b>BUSINESS LINKAGE</b><br>Member office / CRM lead / campaign / conference / IT incident references connect operational tasks to their business context. div.div:
REQUIRES ATTENTION → inspect why / who / evidence → authorised manager decides → intervention is recorded in Layer 2 → resolution returns to reporting
RECOGNITION → validate monthly evidence → three consecutive qualifying months → Chairman sign-off → retain decision and announcement history

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 6382px; height: 1px; padding-top: 9303px; margin-left: 433px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #152735;

div.div: METRIC RULES • Zero denominator: N/A. Missing target: “Target not configured”. Approved leave and external blockers retain context. Reassignment never creates a new task count. Approved deadline changes retain original deadlines and prior overdue history. Rules flag risk; authorised people decide actions.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 6382px; height: 1px; padding-top: 9428px; margin-left: 433px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #152735;
display: inline-block; font-size: 17px; font-family: Verdana; color: light-dark(#152735, #c2d1dd); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: POLICY SETTINGS • Approval / escalation mandates, shifts / grace / breaks, report schedules, appraisal template and recognition scoring remain configurable. CRM royalty uses agreed brokerage shares and lease days; CIRIL receives 7.5% of each party’s share. Integration/import must preserve verified CRM source records.

div.div:
WORK ACTIVITY ≠ TASK STATE
Progress updates, work notes, effort entries and files are historical activity records. A reassignment is an ownership-change event; overdue is an exception flag on unfinished work. Cancellation is a separately authorised outcome.
State Machine Invariant: Task states (Assigned → In Progress → Waiting for Review → Under Review → Closed) are strictly controlled by formal lifecycle transitions, never mutated directly by note additions or file uploads.

Member office / CRM lead / campaign / conference / IT incident references connect operational tasks to their business context. External parties provide inputs; IOTS records staff coordination and accountability.
